findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: guide, task_list, task_show, task_add, search, comment, attachment · Private data: task_list, task_show, task_agent_get, task_agent_register, attachment · Public sink: attachment · Destructive: task_edit, checklist, comment, attachment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: guide, task_list, task_show, task_add, search, comment, attachment · Private data: task_list, task_show, task_agent_get, task_agent_register, attachment · Public sink: attachment · Destructive: task_edit, checklist, comment, attachment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
